onboarding.title: Set up your Budget
onboarding.intro: Your budget data is encrypted on this device before it is saved. It takes four short steps.

passphrase.title: Choose a budget passphrase
passphrase.notFlanerPassword: This is not your Flaner password. Flaner never sees it and cannot reset it by email. If you lose both the passphrase and the recovery key, your budget data cannot be recovered.
passphrase.label: Budget passphrase
passphrase.hint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words work well.

recoveryKey.title: Save your recovery key
recoveryKey.description: If you forget the passphrase, this key unlocks your budget. It is shown only this once, so store it somewhere safe, e.g. in a password manager.
recoveryKey.confirm: I have saved my recovery key

currency.title: Choose your main currency
currency.description: All totals and reports are shown in this currency.
currency.label: Main currency

account.title: Create your main account
account.description: New and imported transactions go here by default. You can add more accounts later.

unlock.title: Unlock your Budget
unlock.description: Enter your budget passphrase to decrypt your budget on this device.
unlock.label: Budget passphrase
unlock.rememberHint: The budget opens here without the passphrase until you lock it in Settings.
unlock.useRecoveryKey: Forgot the passphrase? Use your recovery key

recovery.title: Unlock with your recovery key
recovery.description: Enter the recovery key you saved when you set up the budget. You will choose a new passphrase next.
recovery.label: Recovery key
recovery.hint: 32 letters and digits. Dashes, spaces and capitals are optional.

newPassphrase.title: Choose a new passphrase
newPassphrase.description: Your recovery key worked. Set a new budget passphrase; the recovery key stays valid.

validation.passphraseCommon: This passphrase is too common. Pick something harder to guess.
validation.passphraseContainsIdentity: Don't use your email or username in the passphrase.
validation.recoveryKeySaved: Confirm that you saved the recovery key.
validation.recoveryKeyInvalid: A recovery key has 32 letters and digits.
validation.resetConfirmation: Type the word exactly as shown.
validation.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
validation.amountDecimals: Use at most two decimal places.

transactionsEmpty.title: No transactions yet
transactionsEmpty.description: Import a bank statement file or add a transaction to get started.

changePassphrase.title: Budget passphrase
changePassphrase.description: Change it with the current passphrase or the recovery key. Your data is not re-encrypted.
changePassphrase.dialogDescription: Your devices that remember the budget stay unlocked.

switchTo.recoveryKey: Forgot it? Use the recovery key

recoveryKey.title: Recovery key
recoveryKey.description: Generate a new recovery key. The old one stops working.
recoveryKey.dialogDescription: Save this key somewhere safe. Once you confirm, your old recovery key stops working.

lock.title: Lock budget
lock.description: This device forgets the remembered key and asks for the passphrase next time.

reset.title: Reset budget
reset.description: Delete all budget data and start over. Use it only if you lost both the passphrase and the recovery key.
reset.dialogDescription: This permanently deletes all your budget data: accounts, transactions, categories, rules and plans. It cannot be undone.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: Months you have already opened stay available. Adding and deleting transactions needs a connection.
offline.noConnection: No connection. Your change was not saved.
offline.monthUnavailable: This month hasn't been opened on this device yet, so it isn't available offline.

transactionForm.title: Add transaction
transactionForm.rateMissing: No exchange rate available. Enter the amount yourself.

deleteTransaction.title: Delete this transaction?
deleteTransaction.description: "{{payee}}" will be removed from your budget. This cannot be undone.
